title: Space-time tensor-product finite element methods for parabolic problems
summary: We study space-time Galerkin--Petrov formulations for parabolic evolution problems and their relation to classical implicit time-stepping schemes. Although such schemes are stable in the usual time-stepping sense, their interpretation as space-time operator equations may lead to conditional stability, with constants depending on the relation between temporal and spatial mesh sizes.
